zh: 新增聊天框宠物：Claude 主题默认使用 Crab Buddy，DeepSeek 主题默认使用 Whaledou，按原始 Petdex 图集与逐帧时序播放；原有的像素螃蟹与像素鲸鱼仍可手动选择。
en: Add chat pets: Crab Buddy under Claude and Whaledou under DeepSeek, drawn from their untouched Petdex atlases at the authors' frame times, with the original pixel crab and whale still selectable by hand.
